title: MHADA Pune lottery: 5 days left, the deposit decides
audience: Marathi families in Pune and PCMC applying for the MHADA Pune lottery 2026 (EWS/LIG, first home), 22-50
message: A form without the deposit is not counted in the draw, and the time is almost up.
facts: Online application and deposit (EMD) payment close on 22 October 2026 at 11:59 pm (23:59). Source: MHADA Pune board, second extension of 14 October 2026.
Deposit paid by RTGS or NEFT from a bank is accepted until 23 October 2026 at 3:59 pm (15:59). Source: MHADA Pune board, 14 October 2026.
An application whose deposit is not paid is not counted in the draw. Source: MHADA Pune lottery 2026 advertisement.
The draw is planned for 4 December 2026. Source: MHADA Pune board.
Today is 17 October, so 5 days are left to the online deadline of 22 October.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site.

shots.prompt: A Marathi couple in their early 30s at a simple dining table in a small rented flat in the evening, the wife holding a phone and filling in an online form, the husband leaning in with a hopeful look. A plain wall behind them with nothing on it.
shots.voice: MHADA पुणे लॉटरीचा अर्ज भरलाय? हे नक्की ऐका.

shots.prompt: Close-up over the shoulder of a woman's hands holding a phone, about to tap a button, a cup of tea and a small notebook on a wooden table, soft evening light, the phone screen blurred and unreadable.
shots.voice: अनामत रक्कम भरली, तरच अर्ज सोडतीत मोजला जातो.

shots.prompt: A quiet dim room of a Pune flat late at night, a phone glowing on a table, a sleeping city seen through the window, a calm but urgent mood. No clock, no calendar.
shots.voice: ऑनलाइन अर्ज आणि पेमेंट: 22 ऑक्टोबर, रात्री 11:59 पर्यंत.

shots.prompt: A man in his 30s at the counter of a public sector bank branch in Pune handing a payment slip to the cashier, a simple bank interior, other customers blurred in the background, no signboards.
shots.voice: RTGS किंवा NEFT ने: 23 ऑक्टोबर, दुपारी 3:59 पर्यंत.

shots.prompt: New affordable apartment towers, 12 to 14 floors, plain cream and light-orange paint, on the edge of Pune at sunset, a few families walking on the road in front, construction cranes far away, no signboards.
The same kind of young Marathi couple standing on a small balcony of a new flat at golden hour, smiling and looking at the view, a few plants in pots, happy and hopeful.
shots.voice: अर्ज करणाऱ्या मित्राला हा व्हिडिओ पाठवा.

reply_facts: The homes in this lottery are located in Pune city, Pimpri-Chinchwad and the PMRDA area only.

The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm (extended a second time on 14 October from 15 October); RTGS/NEFT payment by 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm; the draw is planned for 4 December 2026.
An application whose deposit (EMD) is not paid is not counted in the draw.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; Avasetu does not take applications or money.
The pictures in the reel are illustrations, not the lottery's actual buildings.

reply_faq.q: What is the last date, is the deadline over, was it 15 October, RTGS NEFT payment last date?
reply_faq.a: MHADA extended the deadline again on 14 October: apply and pay the deposit online by 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm. If you pay by RTGS/NEFT from your bank, by 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm.

reply_faq.q: How do I check whether my payment went through, application status, receipt?
reply_faq.a: Log in on MHADA's official housing site with the username you made when you registered; your application and its status show on your dashboard. Keep the receipt you got after paying.

reply_faq.q: Where do I apply, which site, apply kahan karna hai?
reply_faq.a: Only on MHADA's official housing site (the link is in the caption). Avasetu does not take applications or money, and nobody needs to be paid to apply.

reply_faq.q: When is the draw, result date?
reply_faq.a: The draw is planned for 4 December 2026. If MHADA changes the date, we will post it.

reply_faq.q: Where are the homes, is it in Nashik, Sambhajinagar, Nagpur, Wardha or another district?
reply_faq.a: The homes in this MHADA Pune board lottery are only in Pune city, Pimpri-Chinchwad and the PMRDA area. Other districts come under other MHADA boards with their own lotteries; we will post about them soon.

reply_faq.q: Are these the actual flats in the video?
reply_faq.a: No, the pictures in the video are illustrations. The actual homes, their prices and sizes are listed scheme by scheme on MHADA's official site.
